# Nix patches

## tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver: missing `permissions/autogenerated/reference.md`

The published `tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver` 1.5.0 crate omits `permissions/autogenerated/reference.md`.
Its `build.rs` runs `tauri_plugin::Builder`, which writes generated schemas and docs under `./permissions`
relative to the manifest directory; a Nix-vendored source tree is read-only. The builder skips a write
when the generated bytes already match, so shipping that one file (and nothing else) lets the
**unmodified** crate build from the read-only tree. The shipped `permissions/schemas/schema.json`
already matches, so no other file is needed.

`tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver/reference.md` here is the file the builder generates (copied from a build of
1.5.0). `cargoVendorDirE2e` in `flake.nix` installs it into the vendored crate via `postPatch`, for the
e2e package only (#233, #241). It replaces the earlier `build.rs` copy-to-`OUT_DIR` patch.

Upstream report: https://github.com/webdriverio/desktop-mobile/issues/730. Drop this directory and the
`overrideVendorCargoPackage` in `flake.nix` once a release that contains the file is pinned in
`Cargo.lock`; if the generated content changes in a newer version, the builder would then fail on the
read-only tree, which is the signal to refresh or drop the file.
